entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What is this...? Joker, try activating it.

entries.speaker: Drained Businessman
entries.en: Work hard... struggle... pursue a faint[n]glimpse of happiness... Is any of that[n]really necessary...?

entries.speaker: Drained Businessman
entries.en: The world is already complete...[n]There's nothing left to do...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell...? Is this some kinda prison[n]cell too...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Plus there are those blood vessel things[n]coming down into it...

entries.speaker: Drowsy Student
entries.en: There's nothing we can do... Parents,[n]teachers... All adults just manipulate us...

entries.speaker: Drowsy Student
entries.en: Nobody listens if we try to oppose them...[n]All that happens is our spirits are crushed...

entries.speaker: Drowsy Student
entries.en: It might be smarter to just accept life for[n]what it is and surrender to their will...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This is just like how I used to be...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If I had stayed like that, I would sound[n]just like her now...!

entries.speaker: Expressionless Man
entries.en: It doesn't matter if something is right or[n]wrong... If there's a rule, we just have to[n]follow it...

entries.speaker: Expressionless Man
entries.en: If anything, those who treat the rules[n]with honor are just, while those who[n]break them are villains...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Uh, you talk about justice, but you know[n]there's something sucking stuff outta your[n]head, right...?

entries.speaker: Befuddled Man
entries.en: Such a foolish group... Your actions will[n]change nothing...

entries.speaker: Befuddled Man
entries.en: All of this is going to end soon anyway...[n]You might as well patiently await your[n]demise...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's all... going to end? What is he saying...?
